deadlines.value: 2026 international undergraduate Chinese-taught route opened 8 December 2025 and closed 5 February 2026; programme-specific 2027 deadlines not confirmed.

international_tuition.value: For English-taught undergraduate programs, official fee notice lists RMB120,000 per academic year (2025 notice); Chinese-taught fees vary by programme.

name: University of Science and Technology of China

english_waivers.value: USTC guide says English-taught programme applicants must provide English proficiency proof; it does not state universal IELTS/TOEFL thresholds. Chinese-taught programmes require HSK.

application_route.value: Direct online application to USTC International College; official undergraduate page lists online application.

international_tuition.value: Latest undergraduate international admissions fee information located on USTC site is from a 2020 guide: RMB26,000 per academic year. Treat as dated; no current 2027 figure found.

international_aid.value: Yes; the same older USTC undergraduate admissions guide says excellent applicants may apply for a USTC Scholarship covering tuition, insurance, monthly RMB2,500 stipend, and dorm fee; current cycle details not found.

english_waivers.value: English-taught programme requirements are separate; Chinese-taught programme requires HSK5 score 180 unless the applicant completed high school in Chinese.

application_route.value: Direct online application through Tongji University Online Registration System.

application_fee.value: RMB600 application fee (Tongji current international-student fee schedule).

deadlines.value: For Fall 2027 bachelor’s entry, self-funded / Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship application window is 10 December 2026–31 March 2027. 2026 guide had 20 January–31 March 2026.

international_tuition.value: Annual tuition in current official fee schedule: Chinese-taught undergraduate programs RMB20,000–28,700/year by subject; English-taught architecture RMB33,800/year, civil engineering RMB35,000/year, MBBS RMB45,000/year.

international_aid.value: Yes; Chinese Government Scholarship bilateral / Silk Road Program for Chinese-taught undergraduates, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship for Chinese-taught undergraduates, and Tongji International Student Excellence Scholarship for English-taught undergraduates.

foundation_for_11_year_schooling.value: Yes, Tongji offers a pre-university program; current fee schedule lists semester 1 RMB14,500 and semester 2 RMB19,350. The 2026 admission guide also says some applicants may be adjusted to preparatory studies after review.
